author: Rusty McMurray / Soulshine; built by Claude at his direction
preserves: v1.1 (receipt fc6b84da...4b50) and v1.2 (prereg 3c1e46ee...d48b, receipt e0a292d1...7872). world.py and v1_readers.py byte-identical to v1.
direction: Rusty, 2026-10-15: 'Every reading is a fresh look at the present terrain from the present position, and the terrain has kept growing the whole time, since noise is food.' Position = BOTH (A) the whole accumulated terrain AND (B) basin occupancy.

rule.no_anchor: A held question is never read through a window or baseline frozen at the hold, and no footprint gates anything. v1.2's new_evidence_check and v1.1's reopen_check are both removed.
rule.A_fresh_look: At every need (unchanged definition), OPEN and HELD questions alike receive the unchanged full look: present span against the whole accumulated history before it, position plus persistence.
rule.B_occupancy: OPERATIONALIZATION BY CLAUDE, flagged for Rusty to replace: while a question is held, its position includes what it has lived through in the high basin. A HELD question proposes only if the full look passes AND the change has persisted through every complete 14-day block since the question was FIRST held (pooled excess over the pre-question baseline, days before first_hold - 41, one-sided z > 2.326 in each block). With no complete block yet, B adds nothing.

experiments.ABLATION_A_ONLY: v1.3 without B, all families, lambda 32 and 128: isolates what occupancy contributes
experiments.BURST_DESCRIPTIVE: poisoning battery v0.1 BURST at b = 5 and 8 on NULL seeds 0-199, lambda 32, same forging as that battery

predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.T2_genuine: GENUINE >= 160 at lambda 32 and >= 240 at lambda 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.T3_positional_confounds: COMMUTE <= 15 and DINNER <= 15 at lambda 32 and 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.T4_difficult_month: WINDOW <= 28 at lambda 32 and <= 78 at lambda 128 (no worse than v1.2). Honest expectation stated in advance: B probably does not fully separate a 30-day transient that is still running from a lasting change; at that moment the two look alike, and only duration distinguishes them.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.T6_action: macro accuracy >= 0.8516 at lambda 32 and >= 0.8836 at lambda 128 (v1.2).
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.T7_information_limit: COLOCATED vs GENUINE |z| < 3 at lambda 32 and 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.T8_cost: MAIN mean region evaluations <= 0.25 x v1 TERRAIN's. Full looks are DESCRIPTIVE: fresh looks at every need are expected to exceed v1.2's 1.39.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.T9_occupancy_matters: WINDOW proposals with B < WINDOW proposals of ABLATION_A_ONLY at lambda 128.

reporting_rule: PASS/FAIL as frozen with exact counts. No change after the first full run.
